auxiliary_suffix.reason: The apparent antioxidant/fragrance region at ranks 8-12 is interrupted by competing silicone vehicles at ranks 13-14. Rank 15 is only a colorant, which cannot establish a boundary.

counter_signal: Ranks 3-5 provide a coherent hydrocarbon/emollient distribution route, making hybrid the strongest rival.
base.reason: The leading silicone carrier plus early silicone gum jointly explain the principal conditioning backbone; later volatile silicones reinforce that family. The hydrocarbon/ether sequence is credible support, but the packet does not give affirmative coequal-backbone evidence strong enough to replace silicone-led with hybrid. Intact oils at ranks 6 and 7 are both retained in inventory.
base.unresolved: Carrier ratios, dimethicone grade and phase behavior are unavailable.

counter_signal: Light: mobile hydrocarbon/ether vehicles and volatile silicones can distribute a smaller conditioning load; dimethicone could be a low-viscosity grade.
Rich: dimethiconol gum and secondary argan oil provide retained-film burden, but do not establish a principal rich structured system.
weight.reason: B1/B5 favor medium because an early silicone carrier/gum conditioning system is the positive residual-load architecture, with the supplied medium argan tendency secondary. B6 does not support rich from one gum or argan alone. Mobile support makes light credible but does not displace the silicone-conditioning interpretation.
weight.unresolved: No amounts, dimethicone/gum grades, evaporation fraction, equal-dose hair-feel or deposited-film observations. Argan prior has explicit light counterevidence.

counter_signal: Botanical oils may have unmeasured fiber interactions; absence of an admitted positive anchor is not evidence that they cannot enter hair.
penetration_potential.reason: The affirmative silicone-film/emollient architecture predominates over the supporting intact oils. This supports a surface-led working estimate without making a blanket statement that all silicones cannot penetrate.
penetration_potential.unresolved: No exact-formula uptake study; blend and laboratory-to-retail extrapolation are untested.

auxiliary_suffix.reason: The conditioning polymer at rank 25 prevents an earlier auxiliary suffix. Rank 26 is a colorant and cannot establish the boundary. Rank 27 is the earliest qualifying functional marker, followed by independent preservative and fragrance functions without a later competing vehicle or structurant.

counter_signal: Silicone-led is plausible if the aqueous/hydrocarbon vehicles mainly deliver the silicone film.
Water-based is weakened because water is not leading and both the hydrocarbon and silicone arms have affirmative functional support.
base.reason: Joint backbone evidence extends beyond the first two ingredients: the hydrocarbon carrier, aqueous vehicle/cosolvent/humectant route, silicone carrier/gum route, and solubilizer/emulsifier/rheology network support an integrated mixed architecture. This is affirmative multi-route evidence, not hybrid by ingredient count or uncertainty. There is no intact botanical oil; PEG-60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil is a derivative.
base.unresolved: Phase continuity, carrier ratios, premix construction and silicone grades are undisclosed.

counter_signal: Light: the hydrocarbon/aqueous/solvent delivery system could leave a relatively small silicone load.
Rich: silicone gum and rheology/conditioning polymers are affirmative retained-system signals, but their functions and unspecified amounts do not establish a principal rich structured coating.
weight.reason: B1/B5 favor medium through the coherent dimethicone/dimethiconol conditioning route with additional modified-silicone and polymer conditioning, carried in the mixed solvent/aqueous system. The lighter delivery architecture is real but does not erase the multi-component conditioning route; B6 lacks a dominant rich-system argument.
weight.unresolved: No quantities, silicone grades, dried residual-load measurements or equal-dose hair sensory evidence; rheology is not equivalent to deposited hair-film dominance.

counter_signal: The aqueous/humectant route can involve fiber interactions that this classification does not measure; water entry is not the admitted whole-oil penetration endpoint.
penetration_potential.reason: Affirmative silicone-conditioning and polymer/emollient architecture supports the surface-led estimate. The modified castor solubilizer is not an intact positive whole-oil anchor. This does not claim universal silicone exclusion from fibers.

auxiliary_suffix.reason: Ranks 19-26 contain only recognized antioxidant and fragrance/allergen auxiliaries. Antioxidants at 19 and 20 count as one function; fragrance at 21 supplies the independent second function. The film/viscosity-capable modified glyceride at 18 prevents an earlier suffix.

counter_signal: Hybrid is the strongest rival because several intact oils plus modified glycerides can contribute materially to the retained system.
base.reason: The continuous early ester/alkane emollient sequence, with supporting emollient solvent at rank 6, positively establishes the principal carrier backbone. Almond, castor, sunflower seed and soybean oils are all counted, but their presence does not establish a co-principal botanical backbone. Angelica seed preparation remains unresolved and is not assigned an intact fixed-oil prior.
base.unresolved: Amounts, grades and Angelica seed preparation are unavailable; exact functions for ranks 8, 11 and 13 are unassessed.

counter_signal: Medium: retained palmitate/emollient contributions, rich-prior castor oil and the modified glyceride film/viscosity route could jointly produce greater coating burden.
Rich: castor plus hydrogenated coco-glycerides supplies a substantive richer counter-signal, but neither their order nor presence establishes principal structural dominance.
weight.reason: B1/B4 favor the coherent ester/alkane distribution architecture with mostly light-prior supporting botanical oils. Castor and modified glycerides are explicitly retained as heavier signals, but there is no affirmative evidence that their structural/conditioning contribution outweighs this carrier architecture; B6 cannot be invoked from a single structurant or richer oil. Light here is a weak sensory-load hypothesis, not an evaporation or negligible-residue claim.
weight.unresolved: No amounts, ester/alkane grades, structurant grade, equal-dose sensory comparison or measured film load. Unassessed extracts/oils and unresolved Angelica preparation remain source gaps; generic emollience alone does not measure lightness.

counter_signal: The intact botanical oils may have unmeasured uptake; no negative inference follows from lacking an admitted positive anchor.
penetration_potential.reason: A coherent principal synthetic emollient carrier architecture, with an additional modified-glyceride film route, predominates over the supporting intact oils. This supports surface-led as a low-confidence architectural estimate, without converting plant derivatives to coconut penetration evidence or asserting that all emollients cannot penetrate.
penetration_potential.unresolved: No exact-formula uptake evidence or carrier ratios; botanical preparation gaps and blend/laboratory-to-retail extrapolation remain unresolved.
